Security review remained open pending recovery evidence and final access-control export.
Draft calendar copied 11 May and inserted placeholder Security sign-off date.
Launch Council withdrew 11 May; no date authorized until all four gates are evidenced.
Product review remained conditional pending duplicate-notification fix and retest.
Second recovery attempt reported; final elapsed time and integrity evidence not attached.
Security reiterated that final run record and access-control export were missing from review record; no production approval recorded.
Status digest confirms no authorized date and gate evidence incomplete.
